editions.title: The reference farm
editions.summary: The current farm, data explorer and independent review baseline, preserved as an edition.

changes.title: Preserved gameplay
changes.description: The deployed reference gameplay and prior progress. Edition routing and navigation are compatibility adaptations; no new audio is added to v1.

editions.title: Editions and a quieter farm
editions.summary: Choose independent editions, follow feedback into changes, and optionally add gentle music and sound effects.

changes.title: Independent editions
changes.description: Each edition has its own saved farm, assumptions, branches, conversations and settings.

changes.title: Feedback to evolution
changes.description: Original reviews retain their tested builds. New changes link to evidence without claiming unrelated findings are fixed.

changes.title: Optional gentle audio
changes.description: Original quiet music and soft effects start muted, with separate controls and per-edition preferences.
